name: Geo Targetly Geo Currency
author: geotargetly

sections.description:
Geo Currency detects where your visitors are coming from and automatically adjusts the prices and currency symbols they see across your WordPress site, no extra coding needed.

You can auto-convert prices based on real-time exchange rates, or manually assign currencies for different regions. Works seamlessly with any static prices on your pages via CSS targeting.

Use this plugin to localize pricing for global audiences, reduce confusion at checkout, and improve international conversion rates.

You’ll also get a tooltip feature that displays the original currency when users hover, so there’s full transparency for your visitors.

This plugin is made by Geo Targetly.

  • Paid account is required – see pricing
  • 14-day free trial – no credit card needed

Features

  • Display prices in the visitor’s local currency based on country or region
  • Choose between auto-conversion (with live FX rates) or manual assignment
  • Tooltip support to show the original price and currency
  • Target prices using CSS class selectors
  • Works on any WordPress page builder or theme
  • No impact on checkout prices, front-end only
  • Easy-to-deploy tracking code, no developer needed
  • Supports multi-region websites and global eCommerce

Detailed docs can be found below

  • Overview https://geotargetly.com/geo-currency
  • Quick Start Guide https://help.geotargetly.com/en/articles/10430834-geo-currency-quick-start-guide
  • Docs https://help.geotargetly.com/en/collections/11374491-geo-currency

Support

  • Live chat at Geo Targetly

External services

This plugin connects to an external endpoint via the domain https://g1980843350.co to load and run a script that powers its core functionality, as outlined previously in the description.

It sends the user’s location each time the plugin is loaded. This is necessary to determine and customize the plugin’s behavior based on the user’s geographical context.

Additionally, this plugin connects to analytics endpoint https://g97676560.co/ to track plugin installation and usage over time.

This service is provided by Geo Targetly – Terms of Use, Privacy Policy.
